usage.surface-canvas: Page background behind the content area.
usage.surface-sidebar: The left navigation column and the mobile tab bar.
usage.surface-card: Cards, tables and list containers on `surface-canvas`.
usage.surface-raised: Hovered rows, popovers, menus and drawers: anything above a card. Pair with a shadow.
usage.surface-scrim: Dimmed backdrop behind modals and drawers.
usage.text-primary: Numbers, titles and body text on every surface.
usage.text-secondary: Labels under numbers, table metadata, inactive nav items.
usage.text-tertiary: Captions, timestamps, placeholder text. Still ≥4.5:1 on every surface.
usage.text-disabled: Disabled controls only (exempt from contrast rules). Never for information.
usage.text-inverse: Text on `text-primary`-coloured fills such as tooltips.
usage.border-subtle: Dividers between rows inside a card.
usage.border-default: Card outlines, table frames, sidebar edge.
usage.border-strong: Input and checkbox outlines: ≥3:1 against the surface so controls are findable.
usage.accent-bg: Selected nav item, selected segment, accent chip fill.
usage.accent-border: Outline of accent chips and selected cards.
usage.accent-text: Links and selected labels on `surface-*` and `accent-bg`.
usage.accent-solid: Primary buttons, active toggles, the one highlighted series in a chart.
usage.success-bg: Chip and banner fill. Finalized, Signed, Submitted on time. Use sparingly: healthy is the default and stays neutral.
usage.success-border: Chip and banner outline; icon stroke on bg. Finalized, Signed, Submitted on time. Use sparingly: healthy is the default and stays neutral.
usage.success-text: Label and icon on `success-bg` and on every surface. Finalized, Signed, Submitted on time. Use sparingly: healthy is the default and stays neutral.
usage.success-solid: Filled badge, chart marker, count badge. Finalized, Signed, Submitted on time. Use sparingly: healthy is the default and stays neutral.
usage.success-on-solid: Text and icons on `success-solid`. Finalized, Signed, Submitted on time. Use sparingly: healthy is the default and stays neutral.
usage.warning-bg: Chip and banner fill. Not yet urgent: Late, Draft past 10:00 warning, labor over target, Reopened, Awaiting HR approval.
usage.warning-border: Chip and banner outline; icon stroke on bg. Not yet urgent: Late, Draft past 10:00 warning, labor over target, Reopened, Awaiting HR approval.
usage.warning-text: Label and icon on `warning-bg` and on every surface. Not yet urgent: Late, Draft past 10:00 warning, labor over target, Reopened, Awaiting HR approval.
usage.warning-solid: Filled badge, chart marker, count badge. Not yet urgent: Late, Draft past 10:00 warning, labor over target, Reopened, Awaiting HR approval.
usage.warning-on-solid: Text and icons on `warning-solid`. Not yet urgent: Late, Draft past 10:00 warning, labor over target, Reopened, Awaiting HR approval.
usage.danger-bg: Chip and banner fill. Act now: Overdue, urgent HR Flags (Workplace injury), Refused.
usage.danger-border: Chip and banner outline; icon stroke on bg. Act now: Overdue, urgent HR Flags (Workplace injury), Refused.
usage.danger-text: Label and icon on `danger-bg` and on every surface. Act now: Overdue, urgent HR Flags (Workplace injury), Refused.
usage.danger-solid: Filled badge, chart marker, count badge. Act now: Overdue, urgent HR Flags (Workplace injury), Refused.
usage.danger-on-solid: Text and icons on `danger-solid`. Act now: Overdue, urgent HR Flags (Workplace injury), Refused.
usage.info-bg: Chip and banner fill. Neutral facts that need a note: Closed (store closed), Ready to deliver, system notices.
usage.info-border: Chip and banner outline; icon stroke on bg. Neutral facts that need a note: Closed (store closed), Ready to deliver, system notices.
usage.info-text: Label and icon on `info-bg` and on every surface. Neutral facts that need a note: Closed (store closed), Ready to deliver, system notices.
usage.info-solid: Filled badge, chart marker, count badge. Neutral facts that need a note: Closed (store closed), Ready to deliver, system notices.
usage.info-on-solid: Text and icons on `info-solid`. Neutral facts that need a note: Closed (store closed), Ready to deliver, system notices.
usage.focus-ring: Keyboard focus outline: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. ≥3:1 on all surfaces.
usage.chart-reference: Comparison series (last week) and target markers in charts; drawn dashed.
usage.chart-current: This period: the one highlighted series in every comparison chart. 2px line, 10% area wash.
usage.chart-prior: Prior period (same weekdays a week earlier): 1.5px dashed line, no fill, no markers.
usage.chart-area: Area wash under the this-period line.
usage.chart-grid: Horizontal gridlines: 1px solid, 3–5 per chart. No vertical gridlines.
usage.chart-axis: Baseline (zero line) only; no other axis lines.
usage.chart-target: Target marker (e.g. 27% labor): 2px tick or 1px dashed rule, labeled.
usage.loc-valencia: Location color: Valencia St · cyan · circle. Same Location, same color and glyph in every chart. Validated all-pairs for CVD and normal vision in both themes.
usage.loc-lake: Location color: Lake Ave · gold · square. Same Location, same color and glyph in every chart. Validated all-pairs for CVD and normal vision in both themes.
usage.loc-court: Location color: Court St · magenta · triangle. Same Location, same color and glyph in every chart. Validated all-pairs for CVD and normal vision in both themes.
usage.loc-mass: Location color: Mass Ave · violet · diamond. Same Location, same color and glyph in every chart. Validated all-pairs for CVD and normal vision in both themes.
usage.loc-lamar: Location color: South Lamar · green · cross. Same Location, same color and glyph in every chart. Validated all-pairs for CVD and normal vision in both themes.
usage.daypart-1: Daypart ordinal ramp, step 1: Morning. Single cobalt hue, ordered in time.
usage.daypart-2: Daypart ordinal ramp, step 2: Midday. Single cobalt hue, ordered in time.
usage.daypart-3: Daypart ordinal ramp, step 3: Afternoon. Single cobalt hue, ordered in time.
usage.daypart-4: Daypart ordinal ramp, step 4: Evening. Single cobalt hue, ordered in time.
usage.mix-1: Product-category mix ramp, step 1 (largest category = 5). Neutral so mix never competes with Location or status color; paint one category `chart-current` to call it out.
usage.mix-2: Product-category mix ramp, step 2 (largest category = 5). Neutral so mix never competes with Location or status color; paint one category `chart-current` to call it out.
usage.mix-3: Product-category mix ramp, step 3 (largest category = 5). Neutral so mix never competes with Location or status color; paint one category `chart-current` to call it out.
usage.mix-4: Product-category mix ramp, step 4 (largest category = 5). Neutral so mix never competes with Location or status color; paint one category `chart-current` to call it out.
usage.mix-5: Product-category mix ramp, step 5 (largest category = 5). Neutral so mix never competes with Location or status color; paint one category `chart-current` to call it out.
usage.seq-1: Sequential heatmap bin 1 (labor % < 27%, on target). Low values recede toward the surface in both themes.
usage.seq-2: Sequential heatmap bin 2 (labor % 27–29%). Low values recede toward the surface in both themes.
usage.seq-3: Sequential heatmap bin 3 (labor % 29–31%). Low values recede toward the surface in both themes.
usage.seq-4: Sequential heatmap bin 4 (labor % 31–33%). Low values recede toward the surface in both themes.
usage.seq-5: Sequential heatmap bin 5 (labor % ≥ 33%). Low values recede toward the surface in both themes.
